key.name: display-mode
key.description: Number of lyric lines to display (single, double, or triple).

key.name: font-family
key.description: Font family used to render the lyric text.

key.name: font-size
key.description: Font size of the active lyric line in points/pixels.

key.name: font-bold
key.description: Whether to render active lyric line with bold weight.

key.name: text-shadow
key.description: Add a soft dark shadow behind text to improve readability against bright backgrounds.

key.name: text-align
key.description: Alignment of lyric lines: left, center, or right.

key.name: active-color
key.description: CSS color string for the active lyric line.

key.name: inactive-color
key.description: CSS color string for preceding and upcoming lyric lines.

key.name: gradient-direction
key.description: Direction of background gradient (none, vertical, horizontal, radial).

key.name: gradient-start
key.description: CSS RGBA color string for the starting color of the background gradient.

key.name: gradient-end
key.description: CSS RGBA color string for the ending color of the background gradient.

key.name: border-radius
key.description: Corner rounding radius of the OSD container in pixels.

key.name: padding
key.description: Internal padding of the OSD container in pixels.

key.name: position-preset
key.description: Screen anchor preset for the OSD overlay.

key.name: offset-x
key.description: Horizontal pixel offset from the selected anchor position.

key.name: offset-y
key.description: Vertical pixel offset from the selected anchor position.

key.name: monitor-index
key.description: Index of monitor to display OSD on (-1 for primary monitor).

key.name: max-width
key.description: Maximum width of the OSD overlay in pixels.

key.name: always-on-top
key.description: Keep the OSD overlay above other windows.

key.name: sync-offset
key.description: Time offset in milliseconds to adjust lyric synchronization.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Transition animation duration in milliseconds.

key.name: enable-netease
key.description: Whether to query NetEase Cloud Music if LRCLIB does not have synced lyrics.

key.name: show-unsynced-lyrics
key.description: Whether to display plain lyrics if synchronized lyrics are not found.

key.name: hide-when-paused
key.description: Automatically hide the OSD when playback is paused or stopped.

key.name: hide-when-no-lyrics
key.description: Automatically hide the OSD when no lyrics are found for current song.

key.name: hide-in-fullscreen
key.description: Hide the OSD overlay when a window is in fullscreen mode.

key.name: show-panel-indicator
key.description: Show an icon in the GNOME Shell top panel for quick actions.

key.name: autostart-on-login
key.description: Automatically start Spotlify when logging into desktop session.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keybinding to toggle OSD visibility.

key.name: osd-visible
key.description: Current visibility toggle state for the OSD.
